tonight.headline: Loveland's status is still open — decide the TE before Sunday noon
body: Bad news first: Colston Loveland's neck is unresolved. At 13:00Z Saturday the Bears had not yet published Saturday's practice report or his game designation; Heavy and Yahoo (31 Oct, overnight) say he has one more practice before a decision, which may come close to kickoff. He plays Monday at 19:15 CDMX. Kyle Pitts, the only bench tight end who can cover him, locks at Sunday 12:00 CDMX, so the call must be made from Saturday's report.

44.1 banked from Thursday; ESPN projects 140.4 to Metcalf Gala's 122.1, 60%. George Pickens is still questionable after three limited days, but he is on the bench and Schottenheimer expects him to play. The lineup as set is the projection lineup.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Jacobs 23.2 and Golden 20.9 final, neither hurt Thursday (Yahoo 30 Oct). Seven starters to play: five Sunday 12:00, Daniels Sunday 19:20, Loveland Monday 19:15. Metcalf Gala have their whole lineup left.

case.label: The decision
case.body: Saturday's Bears report: OUT or DOUBTFUL → start Pitts at TE before Sun 12:00 CDMX. QUESTIONABLE after a Saturday practice → keep Loveland; there is then no bench cover on Monday. No designation → the question disappears.

case.label: The Monday problem
case.body: If he is questionable and then inactive Monday, every bench player but Likely (bye) has already played and is locked. The only Monday-night tight end free in IPADE is Seattle's AJ Barner (90%+ of snaps, 1-3 catches a game, RotoWire), and adding him would mean dropping Likely. That is not a trade worth making for one game; the cost is a zero at TE.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland a full participant Saturday with no designation — or a Ben Johnson quote ruling him out.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — decide by Sun 1 Nov 12:00 CDMX, when Pitts locks
doFirst.title: If Saturday's report rules Loveland out or doubtful, start Kyle Pitts Sr. at TE
doFirst.subtitle: Loveland plays Monday; Pitts plays Sunday at noon. Saturday's Bears report — not yet out at 13:00Z — decides it.

case.label: The news
case.body: Loveland was added to Chicago's report Friday with a neck injury and practised limited (Seahawks.com joint report 30 Oct 17:28; Shaw Local, Heavy, NBC 30 Oct). Chicago did not practise Wednesday or Thursday-estimate him. At 13:00Z Saturday no Saturday report or designation was out; Heavy and Yahoo (31 Oct overnight) say one more practice decides it. No Ben Johnson quote; Sam Roush is the next tight end. Not priced: ESPN's 11.8 assumes he plays.

case.label: The clock
case.body: lineup_check.py sets the check at Monday 17:45 CDMX, 90 minutes before Loveland's kickoff — but Pitts' game starts Sunday 12:00 CDMX and he locks then. A Monday check has no bench tight end left to use. The real check is Saturday's final designation.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Pitts 10.4, against Loveland 11.8 — a 1.4 gap, inside the coin-flip line, so no thesis either way. Penix starts and Pitts is not on Atlanta's report (Yahoo 30 Oct); he has 5+ catches in each of his last three and now lines up wide and in the slot (FantasyLife 29 Oct).

case.label: When to act
case.body: Saturday's Bears report: OUT or DOUBTFUL → make the swap before Sun 12:00 CDMX. QUESTIONABLE after a Saturday practice → leave Loveland in.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Loveland plays and outscores Pitts — or it is not made and Loveland is inactive Monday.

whatWentWrong.title: The tight-end cover plays a day before the starter
whatWentWrong.lead: Loveland is Monday night; Pitts, the only bench tight end who can play this week, is Sunday noon. The lineup tool's Monday check comes too late.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Pitts was added on 28 Oct as the third tight end while Likely is on bye. Nobody checked that his kickoff is a day before Loveland's, so the contingency only works if the decision is made before Sunday 12:00.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The card above: Saturday's designation decides, not Monday's inactives.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland plays Monday with no setback — then this cost nothing this week, though the structure stays wrong for any Monday starter.
